title: Bangladesh Medicine Database
description: Comprehensive database of all medicines available in Bangladesh with complete clinical monograph details, manufacturer data, pricing in BDT, dosage guidelines, indications, contraindications, side effects, and precautions.

all_medicines.description: Exhaustive master dataset of all medicines in Bangladesh with full clinical monographs.

all_medicines_summary.description: Lightweight summary for high-performance indexing and fast browser searching.

generics.description: Clinical monographs of all generic active pharmaceutical ingredients in Bangladesh.

manufacturers.description: Pharmaceutical companies operating in Bangladesh and their brand portfolios.

dosage_forms.description: Dosage forms catalog (tablets, syrups, injections, etc.).

by_company_directory.description: Pre-segmented JSON files for each major pharmaceutical giant in Bangladesh.

by_form_directory.description: Pre-segmented JSON files for each major dosage form category.

interactive_viewer.description: Fast, responsive web app to search, browse, and inspect medicines.

schema.brand_name: Commercial brand trade name in Bangladesh
schema.strength: Dosage strength / concentration (e.g. 500 mg, 10 mg/5 ml)
schema.dosage_form: Physical dosage form (Tablet, Capsule, Syrup, etc.)
schema.unit_price: Official retail price per unit in Bangladeshi Taka (৳)
schema.pack_price: Retail price per pack / container in BDT
schema.package_container: Container description and packaging price string
schema.indications: Comprehensive list of symptoms and diseases indicated for this drug
schema.dosage_and_administration: Official prescribing dosage for adults and pediatrics
schema.administration_route: Route of administration (Oral, Subcutaneous, IV, Topical, etc.)
schema.contraindications: Clinical contraindications where the drug should not be taken
schema.side_effects: Documented adverse effects and side effects
schema.pregnancy_category: FDA Pregnancy Category (A, B, C, D, X)
schema.pediatric_usage: Safety and dosing considerations in children
